newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: Europe and CIS port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

BULGARIA, March 31 - April 6 - Varna - Varna east, Varna west, Balchik - 39 Vessels in port operating of which 28 loading (6 fertiliser, 1 scrap, 2 glass, 1 cellulose, 5 soda, 2 clinker, 1 ntp, 1 frozen chicken/general cargo/containers, 2 tsp, 1 scrap, 3 quartz sand, 1 ntp/soda, 1 edc, 1 kaolin). 4 Discharging (3 phosphorite, 1 coal). 2 Discharging/loading trucks/containers, 5 discharging/loading containers. 10 Vessels waiting in roads of which 4 to load (1 tsp, 1 ntp, 1 quartz sand, 1 sulphuric acid), 6 cargo not nominated.

Bourgas - 21 Vessels in port operating of which 9 loading (1 timber, 1 fertiliser, 1 zinc/timber, 4 steel, 1 clinker, 1 gasoline). 7 Discharging (1 sugar, 1 waste paper, 2 iron ore, 1 zinc concentrate, 1 benzene, 1 petrol). 2 Discharging/loading (1 salt/general cargo, 1 cases). 2 Discharging/loading containers, 1 empty vessel. 11 Vessels waiting in roads of which 5 to load (1 fertiliser, 1 timber, 1 scrap, 1 chemicals, 1 coils), 5 empty, 1 awaiting orders. 23 Vessels due of which 15 to load (1 sugar/containers, 1 metal, 1 fertiliser, 2 general cargo, 1 copper concentrate, 4 steel, 1 baryte concentrates, 1 chemicals, 1 coils/pipes, 1 lead, 1 equipment). 5 To discharge (1 iron ore, 3 coal, 1 coke). 2 To discharge/load (1 salt/coils/zinc, 1 cars/containers/general cargo), 1 to discharge/load containers.

April 7 - Varna - No labour problems. Varna east - 4 vessels loading at berth, 1 discharging at berth, 1 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna west - 12 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth, 3 waiting at anchorage to load. Varna lesport, tanker port - No vessels. Bourgas - No labour problems. Bourgas east - 8 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. 12 Vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 1 waiting to discharge. 4 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 23 due. Bourgas west - 5 Vessels loading at berth, 2 discharging at berth. Tanker port - 3 Vessels discharging at berth.

CROATIA, April 7 - Rijeka - Three vessels discharging at berth, 1 loading at berth, 2 inoperative berths. 7 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 6 due with delays expected. Zadar - Two vessels under repair/dry-docked. Sibenik - Two vessels under repair/dry-docked. Split - One vessel loading at berth, 1 under repair/dry-docked. Ploce - One vessel discharging at berth. Dubrovnik - Three vessels awaiting orders. Pula, Rasa - No vessels.

CYPRUS, April 8 - Limassol - Eight vessels operating of which 4 containers loading/discharging, 4 conventional vessels discharging. 12 Vessels due 9/4 of which 2 containers, 5 conventional vessels, 4 passenger vessels, 1 cruise vessel. Larnaca - Two vessels operating of which 1 container vessel loading/discharging, 1 conventional vessel discharging, 2 vessels due 9/4 of which 1 container vessel, 1 conventional vessel.

ESTONIA, April 8 - No labour problems. Tallinn - City port - 2 Vessels loading at berth (1 map, 1 steel billets), 1 map vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 1 liner vessel, 1 vessel awaiting orders, 4 due. Kopli - 3 Sawn timber vessels loading at berth, 1 meat vessel discharging at berth, 3 vessels due. Muuga - 7 Vessels loading at berth (1 peas, 1 slabs, 2 fuel oil, 1 scrap metal, 2 containers). 3 Discharging at berth (1 poultry, 2 containers). Parnu - Nine vessels loading at berth (5 timber, 1 boards, 3 peat), 10 vessels due.

ITALY, April 8 - Naples, Salerno - No vessels in roads. Gaeta - One reefer vessel etb 9/4 p.m. or 10/4 a.m. Genoa - Commercial port - No vessels in roads, no delays, 33 vessels berthed, 2 dry-docked. Multedo - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 3 vessels berthed. Savona, Vado Lire, Civitavecchia, Gaeta, Naples, Salerno, Palermo, Ancona, Falconara - No vessels in roads, no delays. La Spezia - No vessels in roads, no delays, 7 vessels berthed, 5 under repair/dry-docked. Leghorn - Four vessels in roads, 38 berthed. Augusta - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, 6 berthed. Syracuse - Oil harbour - No vessels in roads, no delays, 1 vessel berthed. Sarroch, Taranto, Ravenna - No delays. Venice - No vessels in roads. Trieste - Two vessels in roads, some delays at Siotil terminal.

LITHUANIA, April 7 - Klaipeda - 26 Vessels in port operating of which 14 loading (1 scrap, 4 fertiliser, 1 metal, 3 ingots, 3 steel coils, 2 timber). 11 Discharging (7 fish, 1 bananas, 1 dolomite stone, 2 sugar), 1 loading/discharging, 3 vessels in roads, 33 due.
POLAND, April 8 - Szczecin - 37 Vessels loading at berth, 26 discharging at berth, 2 waiting at anchorage to load, 3 waiting to discharge. 9 Vessels under repair/dry-docked, 71 due.

PORTUGAL, April 7 - Leixoes - 12 Vessels operating of which 8 general cargo, 3 containers. No Vessels waiting. Vacant places, 2 piers with cranes, 2 piers without cranes. April 8 - Setubal - Four vessels loading at berth, 6 discharging at berth, 5 under repair/dry-docked. 8 Vessels due of which 5 to discharge, 2 to load, 1 for repai/dry-dock. Lisbon - 73 Vessels in port of which 1 loading at berth, 16 discharging at berth, 6 loading/discharging at berth, 3 loading at anchorage. 1 Bunkering, 14 under repair/dry-docked, 5 awaiting orders, 24 miscellaneous craft, 47 due.

ROMANIA, April 7 - Constantza - 25 Vessels operating of which 13 general cargo (9 loading, 4 discharging), 8 bulkers (3 loading, 5 discharging), 2 bagged chemicals loading, 1 tanker discharging. 6 Vessels waiting in roads of which 1 general cargo to load, 2 bulkers (1 to load, 1 to discharge), 3 tankers (2 to load, 1 to discharge). Constantza south (Agigea) - 6 General cargo vessels loading. Mangalia - No vessels loading/discharging. Midia - Four livestock carriers loading.

RUSSIA - BALTIC PORTS - St. Petersburg - April 7 - 24 Vessels operating of which 18 loading (10 non-ferrous metals, 5 fertiliser, 2 general cargo, 1 scrap). 6 Discharging (1 frozen chicken, 2 containers, 1 starch, 1 frozen meat, 1 vegetables). 14 Vessels waiting, 16 due.

FAR EASTERN PORTS - April 8 - No delays, strikes, congestion. Vladivostok - 17 Vessels in port of which 8 loading (2 metal, 3 timber, 1 soya, 1 general cargo, 1 containers). 2 Discharging (1 cars, 1 boric acid), 1 passenger vessel. Nakhodka - 11 Vessels in port of which 6 loading (2 metal, 4 timber). 1 Excavator discharger, 4 waiting. Vostochny - Five vessels in port of which 3 loading timber, 2 discharging/loading containers. Posyet, Zarubino - No vessels.

BLACK SEA - Novorossiysk - April 7 - 20 Vessels in port operating of which 14 loading (1 coal, 1 scrap, 7 steel, 1 wheat, 1 aluminium, 1 citrus, 1 paper, 1 saltpetre). 6 Discharging (1 rice, 1 oranges, 2 sugar, 1 cement, 1 various). 24 Vessels waiting in roads of which 12 to load (5 steel, 1 scrap, 1 paper, 1 lead, 1 copper cathodes, 1 bagged fertiliser, 2 seeds). 12 To discharge (4 sugar, 5 rice, 1 lentils, 2 citrus). 48 Vessels due of which 33 to load (2 scrap, 13 steel, 1 tin, 3 copper, 1 copper cathodes, 1 lead, 1 aluminium, 3 paper, 1 paper/equipment/containers, 1 cellulose, 5 coal, 1 seeds). 13 To discharge (6 sugar, 2 rice, 2 citrus, 3 luggage). 2 To discharge/load containers. Oil terminal - April 8 - 1 Vessel berthed loading fuel oil, 4 tankers waiting in roads of which 1 to load fuel oil, 3 crude oil. 7 tankers due, all to load, of which 5 crude oil, 2 fuel oil. Trunk oil pipe will be under repair from April 8-11.

NORTHERN BASIN - Murmansk - April 8 - Six vessels operating of which 3 alumina, 2 cabotage, 1 apatite, 2 apatite loaders awaiting berths. 14 Vessels due during the week of which 7 loaders (2 non-ferrous metals, 1 steel, 2 cabotage, 2 apatite). 7 Dischargers (2 alumina, 2 cabotage, 2 general cargo1 anode paste).

SLOVENIA, April 7 - Koper - 11 Vessels berthed of which 1 loading/discharging containers, 3 general cargo vessels loading sawn timber, rails, steel wire, 3 bulk carriers discharging chrome ore, alumina, fertiliser, 1 bulk carrier loading coal, 1 car carrier discharging cars, 2 livestock vessels loading bulls. 12 Vessels due over the next 2 days of which 4 to load/discharge containers, 2 car carriers to load cars, 2 general cargo vessels to load sawn timber, drums, 1 livestock vessel to load bulls, 2 bulk carriers to discharge wheat, alumina, 1 bulk carrier to load coal. No delays expected.

SPAIN, April 7 - Aviles - Six vessels in port of which 3 loading steel products, 3 discharging (1 scrap, 1 dunite, 1 steel products). Gijon - Three vessels in port of which 1 discharging coal, 2 loading (1 cement, 1 wire rods). No delays/congestion/strikes at either port. Bilbao - 20 Vessels operating (2 tankers, 18 dry cargo) of which 10 discharging, 4 loading, 6 loading/discharging. No delays. April 8 - Sagunto - 19 Vessels in port operating of which 5 ro-ros discharging/loading general cargo. 13 Vessels discharging (8 steel products, 1 timber, 1 general cargo, 1 bulk ammonia, 1 lead, 1 fresh fruit on pallets). 1 Vessel loading steel products, no vessels berthed outside commercial wharf, no berthing delays.

Pasajes - 17 Vessels in port of which 12 discharging (6 scrap, 1 steel, 1 magnetite, 2 coils, 2 wood-pulp). 2 Discharging/loading cars, 3 loading steel, no delays. Cadiz - 14 Vessels operating of which 3 ro-ros, 2 cement, 2 semolina, 1 clay, 1 ship-building materials, 5 under repair, no delays.

TURKEY, April 7 - Istanbul - Haydarpasa - 5 Vessels operating of which 2 containers, 2 dry cargo, 1 ro-ro, no berthing delays, Galata - 8 Cargo/passenger vessels operating, port congested. Ambarli - 13 Vessels berthed, no berthing
